tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ya na yo gā nut+ta raṃ s+ya marga mū la badz+ra ā tsar+ya gu ro yo ga a dhiṣ+tha no nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi chu gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan kun du gzigs pa'i ye shes li khri'i lhun po dbang sngon ral pa'i spring phreng rnam par g.yo ba can/ /gang gi thugs rje'i zla zer dang 'grogs gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer sa gsum snying gi mun pa sel mdzad cing / /byams dang snying rje'i 'dzul dkar mkhyen pa'i bzhin ras las 'ong kun gsal ye shes snang ba ches cher rgyas mdzad pa/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon dang gnyis med 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis blo gros pad+ma kha 'byed mdzod/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' mdo rgyud dri ma med pa thams cad kyi don gyi snying po/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad/ gegs sel zhing yon tan gyi myu gu thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa bon gcig pu/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ gdam pa zab dgu sna tshogs kyi bcud gcig tu bsdus pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul 'di ni/ spyir mdo rgyud sngags thams cad du bla ma la brten nas lam bgrod par gsungs kyang / tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan par rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen bsgrub las su rung zhing cho ga rgyal bas ji skad gsung ba bzhin/

dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i bla ma kho na las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'bras bu sngon du byed par 'gyur bas/ rang gi gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bla ma'i sku dang / dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa stegs mtho bar na'u bza' dang bcas bkod pa legs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas sogs 'byor pa'i bye brag dang bstun rgya che bar bshams/ rang nyid rten la kha phyogs pas stan nang tshangs can la rdo rje dkyil dkrung gis 'dug nas/ 'di ltar bsam ste khams gsum rigs drug gang du skyes kyang ngan song gsum du ni/ /tsha grang / bkres skom/ glen lkugs sogs sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' bas gzir zhing nyams thag mtho ris gsum na yang lha la 'chi 'pho/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ mi la skye rga na 'chi dang / 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa dang / mi 'dod pa dang 'phrad pa/ dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal/ chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa 'gyur ba dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyi mi khyab/ sdug bsngal de las thar bar byed pa la/ dam pa'i chos ma gtogs pa gzhan thabs med cing / de thob pa la lus rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob par bya dgos na/ de yang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung dgos shing / dpe rus sbal gyi mgrin pa gnya' shing gi bu gar tshud pa ltar rnyed par dka'/ lus thob na'ang skyes pa'i tha mar 'chi ba las ma 'das/ 'chi rkyen mang / 'tsho rkyen nyung / 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba rang thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ rdzas dang / sngags rten 'brel gang gis kyang mi bzlog pas/ de ltar ma byung gong du chos bya zhing / de yang dang por sdug pa spong zhing / dge ba ci nus bsgrub pa dang / lung ma bstan dge bar bsgyur ba nyid lag len gyi gtso bor bya dgos/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can 'di rnams kyang /

rang dag 'brel med ma yin/ skye ba snga mar phan btags shing gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin can pha ma sha stag yin pas/ 'di thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba la spyod cing / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral bar bya/ de ltar byed nus pa sangs rgyas kho na yin pas de bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ lam 'di lta bu nyams su blang bar bya/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la/ bdag dang pha ma rigs drug thams cad skyabs su 'gro snyam du bsam la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes las/ dang po ni skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa yin la/ gong du smos pa'i bsam pa'i de lta bus/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ lan bdun/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa'i lam bla ma'i rnam 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mdun du rten bsam pa/ de la mchod pa 'bul ba༞ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa dang bzhi las dang po ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang / nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mnyam pa med pa'i bka' drin can/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs drug pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid las mi 'gyur bas/

sku mdog sngon po/ de kho na nyid ro gcig par rtogs pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pas phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pas stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i dngul dkar gyi dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas bzung ba/ 'khol ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' mnan pas zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs shing / sku mdzes pa'i dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas zab mo rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ thugs bde stong dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa/ bdag la dges pa'i 'dzum mdangs can/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' sna tshogs pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan 'od kun tu 'phro bas rnam par brgyan pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mchog stsol bar mdzad pa/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin āḥdamar po/ thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po/ gzhan yang sku dge 'dun/ gsum dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ phung po lnga chos nyid dang bcas pa rgyal ba rigs drug 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ tshigs dang rtsa rgyus dbang po drug rnams byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ tshigs chen bcu khro bo dang khro mo/ /yul 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga mchod pa'i lha mo'i ngo bo/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/

'phags pa rang sangs rgyas/ nyan thos/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong / gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyi yongs su bskor zhing dges par bzhugs pa gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ thog mar gsol ba btab pa/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mdun gyi rten de rnams thams cad dang / khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ ngag tu/ 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyis ngo bo nyid/ /grub stsol yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bka' bsrung rnams kyi mnga' bdag bla ma la/ /sgo gsum dngas bas kun nas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /nus pa phul byung chos skyong bsrung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid byung bdag pos ma bzung dang / /bdag lus dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun du bzang po yi/ /rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas legs bkod de/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams ma lus pa/ /legs par bkang ste sgo gsum dngas bas 'bul/ /bgyis dang bgyid bstsal bgyi la yi rang ba'i/ /thogs med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa kun/ /'gro ba kun gyis bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / /lhan cig rab mnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags/ /kun gyi dge la rjes su yi rang bzhin/ /rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge rnams bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa thams cad las/ /nye bar skyobs pa'i skyabs gnas mchog nyid du/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las bskyab du gsol/

/myang 'das bskal pa'i gnas la drang du gsol/ /'dod dgu rin chen ma lus bstsal du gsol/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa la gsum/ bdag po yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa/ mchod yon me tog sogs thun mong gi mchod pa/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon gyi mchod pa dbul ba'o/ /dang po bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'jig rten na/ /bdag pos ma bzung nags tshal sman ljongs dang / /lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu la sogs pa'i/ /yid 'ong dngos pa'i khyad par 'di dag 'bul/ /gnyis pa mchod yon sogs thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo bla bre 'phan gdug dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdan khri khang bzang sogs/ /thun mong mchod pa'i khyad par 'di dag 'bul/ /gsum pa gzugs sogs 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lnga/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zlar bcas/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs/ /phyi rol 'dod dgu'i yo byad tshogs rnams 'bul/ /gnyis pa nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ thun mong ma yin sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /rang lus ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs te/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems nyan rang chos bsrungs nor lhar 'bul/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ bde stong ye shes mchog bskyed btsun mo'i mchog /dga' bzhi'i mthar thug lhan skyes bde ba che/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam zung 'jug mchod pa 'di/ /chos rje bka' drin can la 'bul bar bgyi/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod yul mchod mkhan mchod rdzas 'di rnams kyang / sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor so sor snang mod kyi/ /don dam rang rigs 'od gsal spros bral ba'i/ /snang srid phyag rgya chen mo'i mchod pa bzhes/ /gsum pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/

thog mar gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bla ma sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dngos/ /ye shes lnga dag yan lag bdun ldan zhing / /'khor 'das kun khyab brtan g.yo'i dpal gcig pu/ /dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas dge 'dun gtso/ /chos skyong nor lha'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ /rtsa yig rlung sems dri ma sbyang du gsol/ /yul kun nang stong shes pa gsal stong dang / /'khor 'das bde stong mchog tu rtogs par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas nor lha rnams 'od du zhu/ chos skyong la thim/ de nyan thos la/ de rang rgyal la/ de byang sems la/ de sangs rgyas la/ de yi dam la/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ de rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ de la gus 'dud dung dung pa byas la bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po dang / oṃ yig ge phreng ba byung / rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang bas/ lus rtsa'i dri ma sbyangs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i ā las 'od dmar po dang / a yig ge phreng ba byung / rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang bas/ ngag yi ge'i dri ma sbyangs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po dang hūm̐ yig gi phreng ba byung / rang gi snying kha nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang bas/ yid bdud rtsi'i dri ma sbyangs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar thing gsum dang / yi ge 'bru gsum gyi phreng ba byung / rang gi gnas gsum du zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang bas snying po ye shes rlung gi dri ma sbyang / dbang bzhi pa thob/

sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs snyam du mos nas cung zad mnyam par gzhag bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa ni/ yang gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ dpag yas byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen chos kyi rje/ /bdag la myur du thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi dka' spyad 'bad pa cher byas kyang snying po'i don mchog rtogs par ma 'gyur bas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyis/ /ye shes gzigs pa mngon sum 'jug gyur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas bla ma de rang gi spyi bor byon zhing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la gnyis su med par thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur te chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa yin no snyam du sems ma yengs par mnyam par gzhag go /de las rnam rtog gi yun lang na yang 'di ltar bsam ste/ phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni/ rang gi sems yin te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin/ sems de yang sgyu ma yin te/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i dus na sna tshogs su snang la/ rgyu rkyen ma tshogs na gang du yang mi snang bas sgyu ma yin/ sgyu ma tsam du yang bden pa ma yin te/ kun rdzob tu snga ma la brten nas phyi ma 'byung ba rten 'brel yin zhing / don dam par rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas brjod bral yin no snyam du/ rnam rtog ma skyes bar du rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bar chad sel zhing dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/

/zab mo'i lam mchog bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /the tshom yid gnyis spangs te rtse gcig bsgom/ /byin rlabs rtags mtshan 'phral du 'byung bar shog /kun rdzob bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyis dngos/ /don dam bla ma 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ /rang rig bla ma rang sems gdod ma'i mgon/ /snang srid bla ma'i ngo bor rtogs par shog /skye ba 'di dang ji srid sangs rgyas bar/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan bla ma mchog /nam yang 'bral med dad pas rab brten cing / /zhal gyi bdud rtsis rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /gtsug gi nor bu bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /rdo rje'i chos skyong nus mthu dpag yas pas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin rtag tu 'grub gyur cig /ces pa bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab ste spyod lam thams cad du bla ma'i zhabs tog dang 'phrin las ci 'grub kyi bya ba la 'bad cing sgyu ma lta bur rang gzhan gyi don bya ba dang / mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus te chos mthun gyi spyod pas ci bder bya'o/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i chu gter chen po las/ /bslu med rje btsun mchog gis ded dpon gyis/ /man ngag nor bu'i phreng ba rab blangs pa/ /kun gyi gtsug tor rnal 'byor 'di yin no/ /kye ma da ni snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /rnal 'byor tshud zos stong log ma byed par/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi rtag dran byos la/ /rtse gcig zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom re ran/ /des na tshe 'di'i 'dun ma blos btang nas/ /rnal 'byor zab mo 'di la nan tan gyis/ /g.yeng med brjed med bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /kha tsam min par snying nas yang yang soms/ /dmyal bar song yang re sa gzhan med snyam/ /snying nas dad gus kha zhe mthun byas na/ /nam yang mi bslu thugs rjes myur bzung nas/ /bde chen mchog gi gnas su 'dren par nges/ /'di tsam dge ba kun+da'i phung po ltar dkar gang thob des/

/skye dgu mtha' dag sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che las rab sgrol te/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sa dang lam rnams rim gyi myur bgrod nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam grol ye shes bde ba che la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni la stod lho'i sa skyong nus ldan dbang po shrī gu ru rat+na bha dra'i gsung gis bskul bas rkyen byas shing gzhan yang don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul nas/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa glang gi lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer lnga la dpal byas 'gyur rdo rje'i ri khrod du brtsams pa'i yi ge pa ni tsan+t+ra kīrti'o/ /nyams len rgyas par spro na kho bos logs su bris yod/ /e waṃ// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
